rows.why: § 84-712(3)(b),(3)(b)(i) verbatim on the codified page; no per-page figure in law; 25-cent AG safe harbor correctly kept as guidance in notes (verbatim on AG Outline Rev. 7/2024), not as a value; 'actual added cost' ceiling binds every custodian incl. cities (§ 84-712.01(1)); source line ends Laws 2024, LB43, § 8 — no later amendment.

Both quoted clauses ((3)(a) any-form; (3)(b) actual-added-cost ceiling) verbatim; statute indeed has no color-specific rate; actual_cost_standard with null value is the right resolution; municipal scope confirmed via § 84-712.01(1).
Same clauses verbatim; no oversized/nonstandard-size provision anywhere in § 84-712; actual_cost_standard with null value correct; municipal scope confirmed.

(3)(a) and (3)(b)(i)-(iii) verbatim incl. computer run time / analysis-and-programming components; no specialty schedule in law; null value correct; § 84-712(3)(f) no-new-format clause present as cited in notes.
No graduated per-page bands anywhere in the opened § 84-712 text; quoted general ceiling verbatim; 'silent' is the right word.

'No special service charge or fee shall be charged for copies of blank forms or pages that have all meaningful information redacted' verbatim in (3)(c); it is categorical, not a page count — 'silent' for a free-page ALLOWANCE is correct.

(3)(c) and (3)(d) verbatim; basis is existing salary/pay obligation with no dollar rate; resident 8-hour allowance and nonresident hour-zero regime both present; actual_cost_standard with null value correct.

Same clauses verbatim; the resident attorney-review prohibition and the nonresident proportional attorney-review permission are both exactly as quoted; the two-regime split in notes matches the statute.

(3)(b)(ii)-(iii) verbatim; analysis-and-programming is an actual-added-cost component with no rate; the flagged ambiguity (programming vs the (3)(c) 8-hour list) is real — (3)(c) enumerates only searching, identifying, physically redacting, copying.

All three clauses ((3)(c), (3)(d), (5)) verbatim; 'first eight cumulative hours' exact; resident/news-media definition exact; value 8 with prohibition-on-charging-below correct; nonresident hour-zero correct.

No billing increment or rounding rule in the opened section; 'silent' correct.
(3)(c) and (5) verbatim; eight cumulative hours fixed by statute; news media resident regardless of domicile confirmed; value 8 correct.

AG Outline (Rev. 7/2024, opened) contains the quoted passage verbatim incl. 'responsive to a particular records request'; statute has no per-requestor-per-period counter; 'silent' correct; effective_status correctly labels the quote as guidance, not law.
§ 84-712(4) verbatim: estimate of expected cost is a mandatory component of every response (4 business days) with no dollar threshold; 'structural' with value 0 is a fair encoding.

No revised-estimate or variance rule in the opened section; 'silent' correct.

No deposit-amount cap or percentage in the opened section; 'silent' correct.
(3)(g) verbatim; the only statutory prepayment gate is the optional deposit at estimates over $50; structural enum matches.
(4) verbatim; the statutory lapse attaches to nonresponse to the estimate (10 business days), not nonpayment, exactly as the row's notes state; value 10 correct.
No clock/grace/lapse rule for an unpaid deposit in the opened section; 'silent' correct.
No overrun/re-issue/collection-above-estimate rule in the opened section; 'silent' correct.

No amount-based no-charge floor; (3)(h) waiver is discretionary and public-interest based, verbatim; 'silent' correct.

notes: All 36 rows verified against sources opened 2026-08-19: nebraskalegislature.gov codified pages for §§ 84-712, 84-712.01, 84-712.02, 84-712.03, 25-1280, 13-609 (full text downloaded and clause-matched programmatically, whitespace/curly-quote normalized) and the AG 'Outline of Nebraska Public Records Statutes' at ago.nebraska.gov/public-records (page carries 'Rev. 7/2024'; the two Outline-sourced quotes and the NE-9001 25-cent safe-harbor sentence are verbatim on it). Source lines confirm currency: 84-712 ends 'Laws 2024, LB43, § 8'; 84-712.03 'Laws 2024, LB43, § 10'; 13-609 'Laws 2024, LB1074, § 60'; 25-1280 'Laws 1977, LB 126, § 1'. Municipal scope confirmed: fee clauses bind 'the public body, public entity, or public official which is the custodian' and § 84-712.01(1) includes any 'county, city, village, political subdivision'; the agency-only regimes (§ 84-712(3)(e) portal fees; § 84-712.01(2) county modem fee) are correctly excluded from municipal resolutions. Residual caveats already flagged by discover and not verifiable here: Op. Att'y Gen. No. 01029 (2001) not openable (AG archive starts 2003) — affects only guidance rule NE-9001's provenance, no resolution row; the claimed 2026 LB 525/LB 1096 amendments to § 84-712.05 (exemptions) were not independently opened — immaterial to fee rows, and the codified fee sections' source lines show no post-2024 change.
